header.context: cwd/env supplied to unmodified runtime path source in isolated vm; no external npm dependencies
header.corrections: Only cases with reference_expected differ; expected is the required result. Forty-eight rows differ: three root-parent parse rows, four cross-server relative rows, four cross-share relative rows, seven basename rows whose runtime result kept the trailing separators of a partly matched suffix, and thirty Windows normalize rows whose runtime result prefixed a name with no colon (a reserved name plus one more character).
header.drive_keys: Windows per-drive keys are ASCII case-insensitive; the input snapshot stores canonical =X: keys.
